global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with tender noodles, topped with a pink naruto fish cake and chopped green onions. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white base, blue and green swirling pattern, and a slightly textured, glossy rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pink swirl center, white outer layer, scalloped edge, smooth surface with subtle texture.
